name: The first fragment recovered

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Grom’tor brings the first fragment back to Oronok. The piece is now accounted for, but it is only one part of the whole and the task passes to the next son’s trail. The story pauses on the object that survived Gul’dan’s words across a broken world. Its physical markings remain an original illustration; no invented script is treated as readable canon.
